title: Instant Scene Object Selection
description: Clicking a scene object takes ~4s to show as selected. Root cause: controlled selection path in RegistryProvider calls onSelect but skips local state, so ObjectItem props stay stale until the full ProductView shell re-renders from controller emit(). Fix with synchronous selection external store + optimistic updates on click.
summary: Fixed ~4s delay when clicking scene objects under controlled selection (scene play / shell hosts). Root cause: RegistryProvider skipped local state on pick and ObjectItem only read stale host props until ProductRuntime generation bumped and the full shell re-rendered. Added createSelectionSnapshotStore with synchronous subscribe/getSnapshot updates on pick; ObjectItem and SceneSelectionInvalidateBridge now read live selection via useLiveSceneSelection; setSelectedObjectIds always updates the store before notifying the host. ScenePlayShellController gained subscribeSnapshot/notifySnapshot so useScenePlaySnapshot uses useSyncExternalStore and viewport props refresh without waiting on the full shell tree. 106 unit tests pass.
